description: Calendar, one row per day 1968-2030. Also the semantic layer's time spine.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: Key: calendar day; ISO date, 1968-01-01 to 2030-12-31.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Attribute: calendar year.

columns.name: quarter
columns.description: Attribute: quarter of the year, 1-4.

columns.name: month
columns.description: Attribute: month of the year, 1-12.

columns.name: year_month
columns.description: Attribute: month as YYYY-MM, matching dim_period month keys.

columns.name: year_quarter
columns.description: Attribute: quarter as YYYY-Qn, matching dim_period quarter keys.

columns.name: month_name_sv
columns.description: Attribute: Swedish month name in lower case, januari to december.

columns.name: iso_day_of_week
columns.description: Attribute: ISO day of week, 1 Monday to 7 Sunday.

columns.name: is_month_start
columns.description: Attribute: true on the first day of a month.

columns.name: is_month_end
columns.description: Attribute: true on the last day of a month.

description: Reporting periods: year (2024), quarter (2024-Q1), month (2024-03), pooled_years (2021-2024, Folkhälsomyndigheten's county results) and survey_round (ESS11). start_date and end_date join dim_date; reference_year aligns periods of different types.

columns.name: period_key
columns.description: Key: 2024, 2024-Q1, 2024-03, 2021-2024 (pooled years) or ESS11 (survey round).

columns.name: period_type
columns.description: Attribute: year, quarter, month, pooled_years or survey_round.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Foreign key to dim_date: first day of the period; for an ESS round, 1 January of the fieldwork start year.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: Foreign key to dim_date: last day of the period; for an ESS round, 31 December of the fieldwork end year.

columns.name: reference_year
columns.description: Attribute: year the period is compared under; the last year of a pooled span, an ESS round's nominal year.

columns.name: period_label
columns.description: Attribute: display label; the key itself, with fieldwork years added for ESS rounds.

description: Swedish regions on SCB codes: country 00, counties (2 digits), municipalities (4 digits), AKU's aggregate 0050 and the eight NUTS2 areas used by ESS.

columns.name: region_code
columns.description: SCB region code: 00 the country, two digits a county, four digits a municipality, 0050 an aggregate. Facts name it region_code, or municipality_code when only municipalities occur.

columns.name: region_level
columns.description: Attribute: country, county, municipality, aggregate (AKU's 0050) or nuts2.

columns.name: county_code
columns.description: The county a county or municipality belongs to; NULL for other levels.

columns.name: nuts2_code
columns.description: NUTS2 area of a county or municipality, and of a NUTS2 row itself.

columns.name: kolada_region_id
columns.description: Kolada's id for the same region (0000, 00LL, KKKK).

columns.name: region_name
columns.description: Attribute: region name as SCB publishes it, or the NUTS2 area name.

columns.name: county_name
columns.description: Attribute: name of the county a county or municipality belongs to; NULL for other levels.

columns.name: nuts2_name
columns.description: Attribute: name of the NUTS2 area (riksområde); NULL when the region has none.

columns.name: sex_key
columns.description: Key: T total, K women (kvinnor), M men.

columns.name: name_sv
columns.description: Attribute: Swedish name: Totalt, Kvinnor or Män.

columns.name: name_en
columns.description: Attribute: English name: Total, Women or Men.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.description: Attribute: display order, 1 Total, 2 Women, 3 Men.

description: Age bands as sources publish them. Bands from different sources overlap and are compared only like with like.

columns.name: age_group_key
columns.description: Key: age band as published, such as 15-74, 16+ or ALL (no age breakdown).

columns.name: age_min
columns.description: Attribute: lowest age in the band; years; NULL for ALL.

columns.name: age_max
columns.description: Attribute: highest age in the band; years; NULL for open bands (16+) and ALL.

columns.name: age_group_label
columns.description: Attribute: Swedish display label, such as 16–84 år or Alla åldrar.

description: Every indicator in fct_indicator, with unit, welfare domain and direction.

columns.name: indicator_key
columns.description: Key: source prefix plus code, such as aku_unemployment_rate, ess_ppltrst or kolada_N03937.

columns.name: source_key
columns.description: Foreign key to dim_source: the publishing source (scb, fk, fohm, ess, kolada).

columns.name: domain
columns.description: Attribute: finer welfare area used on the site, such as jobb or mental_halsa.

columns.name: measure_type
columns.description: count_flow (add over time and space), count_stock (add over space, not time), rate and share (non-additive: recompute from components or weight), mean_score (survey mean), median (not aggregable).

columns.name: time_rule
columns.description: How values over periods combine into a longer period.

columns.name: space_rule
columns.description: How values over regions, sexes or ages combine.

columns.name: source_code
columns.description: Attribute: the source's own code for the indicator (AKU status, FoHM measure, ESS variable, Kolada KPI id).

columns.name: indicator_name
columns.description: Attribute: indicator name in Swedish.

columns.name: unit
columns.description: Attribute: unit of fct_indicator.value in Swedish (procent, antal, medelvärde 0-10); NULL for Kolada, see description.

columns.name: welfare_dimension
columns.description: Attribute: dimension as in SCB's Nya mått på välfärd, such as ekonomisk or social.

columns.name: higher_is_better
columns.description: Attribute: true when a higher value is better, false when worse; NULL when no direction applies.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Attribute: Swedish description of what the indicator measures; Kolada's KPI description for Kolada.

columns.name: weight_indicator
columns.description: Attribute: indicator_key to weight by when combining regions (scb_population for FoHM); NULL when none.

columns.name: components
columns.description: Attribute: formula of the indicator's additive components in the facts, for recomputing; NULL when none.

columns.name: aggregation_note
columns.description: Attribute: plain-English rule for aggregating the indicator correctly.

columns.name: source_key
columns.description: Key: short source id: scb, fk, fohm, ess or kolada.

columns.name: source_name
columns.description: Attribute: name of the statistics product.

columns.name: publisher
columns.description: Attribute: publishing organisation.

columns.name: homepage_url
columns.description: Attribute: source homepage url.

columns.name: licence
columns.description: Attribute: licence or terms of use as stated by the source.

columns.name: citation
columns.description: Attribute: citation text to show with the data.

description: ICD-10 chapters as grouped by Försäkringskassan, plus F43 inside F00-F99.

columns.name: diagnosis_code
columns.description: Key: ALL, an ICD-10 chapter as Försäkringskassan groups it (such as F00-F99), or F43.

columns.name: diagnosis_label
columns.description: Attribute: Swedish label of the diagnosis group.

columns.name: parent_diagnosis_code
columns.description: Attribute: enclosing group, ALL for a chapter and F00-F99 for F43; NULL for ALL.

columns.name: is_psychiatric
columns.description: Attribute: true for F00-F99 and F43, the psychiatric diagnoses.

description: ESS participating countries.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: Key: ESS two-letter country code.

columns.name: country_name_sv
columns.description: Attribute: country name in Swedish.

columns.name: country_name_en
columns.description: Attribute: country name in English.

columns.name: is_nordic
columns.description: Attribute: true for the Nordic countries pooled in the NORDIC group.

columns.name: is_eu27
columns.description: Attribute: true for EU-27 member states, pooled in the EU27 group.

description: All headline values on one grain. The table to join across domains.

columns.name: indicator_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_indicator: which indicator the value measures; unit and aggregation rules live in dim_indicator.

columns.name: region_code
columns.description: Key, references dim_region: SCB region code: 00 country, county, municipality, 0050 or a NUTS2 area, per source.

columns.name: period_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_period: year, quarter, month, pooled years or ESS round, depending on the source.

columns.name: sex_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_sex: T total, K women, M men.

columns.name: age_group_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_age_group: age band as the source publishes it; ALL where the source has no age breakdown.

columns.name: value
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: headline value in the indicator's own unit (see dim_indicator.unit and measure_type).

columns.name: ci_low
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: lower interval bound in the value's unit (AKU rate minus margin, FoHM or ESS 95% bound); NULL for other sources.

columns.name: ci_high
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: upper interval bound in the value's unit (AKU rate plus margin, FoHM or ESS 95% bound); NULL for other sources.

columns.name: sample_size
columns.description: Measure, additive: FoHM responses or ESS respondents behind the value; count of responses; NULL for register sources.

description: AKU labour force survey (SCB). Rate denominator depends on labour_status: employment and participation over population, unemployment over labour force.

columns.name: region_code
columns.description: Key, references dim_region: 00 the country (monthly) or a county (annual and quarterly), plus AKU's aggregate 0050.

columns.name: period_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_period: YYYY or YYYY-Qn for counties, YYYY-MM for the country.

columns.name: sex_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_sex: T total, K women, M men.

columns.name: age_group_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_age_group: 15-74 for counties; AKU's published age bands for the country.

columns.name: series_type
columns.description: Key: unadjusted, seasonally_adjusted or trend; counties are unadjusted only.

columns.name: labour_status
columns.description: Key: population, employed, unemployed, labour_force or not_in_labour_force.

columns.name: persons_thousands
columns.description: Measure, additive: persons in the labour status, thousands; adds over regions and sexes, not over periods.

columns.name: persons_thousands_moe
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: 95% margin of error of persons_thousands, thousands; counties only, NULL for the country.

columns.name: rate_pct
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: rate for the status, employed and labour force over population, unemployed over labour force; per cent.

columns.name: rate_pct_moe
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: 95% margin of error of rate_pct, percentage points; counties only, NULL for the country.

description: Population on 31 December (SCB). The total over sexes is derived and flagged.

columns.name: region_code

columns.name: period_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_period: calendar year, YYYY.

columns.name: sex_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_sex: T total (derived as K plus M), K women, M men.

columns.name: period_end
columns.description: Attribute: 31 December of the year, the reference date of the count; ISO date.

columns.name: population
columns.description: Measure, additive: inhabitants on 31 December; count of persons; adds over regions and sexes, never over years.

columns.name: is_derived_total
columns.description: Attribute: true when the row is the T total summed from women and men, false for SCB's published cells.

columns.name: is_perturbed

description: Sjukpenningtal 2.0 (Försäkringskassan), monthly from 2021, rolling twelve months.

columns.name: sick_pay_rate
columns.description: Sickness benefit rate: paid sick days per insured person per year, not a per cent.

columns.name: region_code
columns.description: Key, references dim_region: 00 the country, two-digit county or four-digit municipality.

columns.name: period_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_period: month, YYYY-MM; the rate covers the twelve months to it.

columns.name: sex_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_sex: T total, K women, M men.

columns.name: age_group_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_age_group: five-year bands such as 15-19 to 65-69, 15-69 the total.

columns.name: period_start
columns.description: Attribute: first day of the month; ISO date.

columns.name: sick_pay_rate_suppressed
columns.description: Attribute: true when Försäkringskassan suppressed sick_pay_rate.

columns.name: insured_persons

columns.name: sick_pay_days

description: Started and ongoing sick-leave cases (Försäkringskassan). F43 is inside F00-F99; never add them.

columns.name: case_type
